segments.name: Communications Services
segments.description: Provides cloud-based communications services and on-premise devices to business and residential customers, mainly in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: We refer to Ooma Office, Ooma Enterprise, Ooma AirDial, 2600Hz, FluentStream, Phone.com and OnSIP collectively as Ooma Business.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay monthly subscription fees for communications services and buy or rent on-premise and end-point devices through Ooma sales representatives, distributors, retailers and resellers.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues primarily from the sale of subscriptions and other services for our business and residential communications solutions.
